title: Music
description: Immersed in music from a very young age, and after an unsuccessful first attempt at playing the trombone, I took up the electric bass, an instrument that has always fascinated me. My main influences are Pink Floyd, Queens of the Stone Age, Foo Fighters and Blue Oyster Cult. Since my university years, I have joined around ten rock and metal bands in and around Strasbourg, and later around La Roche-sur-Yon. With extensive live performance experience, I recently joined a Pink Floyd tribute band.
